question: Can a candidate-marginal-preserving change in imagined random-stream dependence reach the native CCE safety-mode switch at one fixed first query, and, only if qualified, mediate actual safety cost?
new_evidence_chain: A native predicted-safety-count switch, with a same-forecasts always-minimum-cost control. This is a new consumer test of an old sampling mechanism, not a new attack family or a claim of novelty.
prior_negatives_preserved: Strong-CEM CartPole comparisons did not establish general harm.
Cosmos fixed K8 bank could not select the bad branch; no new Cosmos roots or seeds.
SafeDreamer Vector cost<0 switch is unreachable in the inspected configuration and is not a substitute.

checkpoint.strictness: Verify all inference-consumed variable names, shapes and finite values; do not accept silently initialized inference parameters. Retain unused optimizer and training-state keys as such.

fixed_instance.query: first actual observation after the first seeded reset, before any physical action

stages: Isolated runtime and pinned assets; no training or model API. Verify native-equivalent observation rendering, actual first-reset seed and inference variable compatibility.

One native first-query inference and latency/resource profile; save posterior, proposal inputs, RNG context, final candidate actions, costs, rewards, elites and action. This is not Clean task competence.

Only after native calibration, replay the final CEM iteration with identical fixed actions and per-time independent categorical randomness shared across the candidate axis. Do not reuse a categorical sample across candidates with different logits. Protect posterior and all earlier rounds.
If native and shared-stream safety counts do not cross 50, stop this fixed candidate. No alternate query, root, threshold, seed, horizon or coupling search.

If the switch is reached without padding contamination, qualify one full unchanged native Clean episode within the frozen resource cap before any claim or execution of attack utility. Record actual environment rewards, costs and goal completions.

Only after qualified Clean, specify and execute a separate frozen four-condition physical continuation protocol: independent/shared streams crossed with native/always-minimum-cost branch, all with unchanged mean/momentum execution. This file does not authorize opportunistic selection of continuation length or outcomes.

sampler_contract.protected: Complete initial posterior, model weights, physical state, observation, proposal actions and scoring functions at the final fixed iteration.
sampler_contract.invariant: For each fixed candidate its complete imagined trajectory law is unchanged: use the runtime native OneHotCategorical row law independently across its 48 coordinates and fresh keys at each model rollout step; share only the per-step key across candidates. Thus candidate safety probabilities and expected safe count are unchanged; the joint safe-count distribution may change.
sampler_contract.implementation_gate: Resolve exact TFP/JAX categorical sampler semantics and random-call ordering before inference. Native calibration must reproduce the fixed final-round input, scores and action; any numerical adapter must be declared and justified before use.
sampler_contract.permission: Added restricted research sampler in the imagined RSSM only; no deployed third-party access is claimed.
sampler_contract.implementation: Use vmap of the unchanged runtime OneHotDist.sample on each candidate logits[48,48] with the same actual native per-step key. Capture all15 actual prior keys and16 full proposed actions, or equivalent complete RNG+reserve state; do not recreate Ninjax key splitting by guesswork.

identification_controls.mode_control: Always use the all-candidate negative-cost branch on exactly the same forecast, cost and return tensors. Never force a reward branch when fewer than 50 safe candidates exist.
identification_controls.padding_gate: Track original candidate IDs and validity through fixed-size nonzero and top_k. If a selected elite comes from padded entries, stop pure safety-switch attribution; do not repair then relabel as unchanged native.
identification_controls.execution: Use the native 0.1 old mean + 0.9 elite mean action. Candidate safety labels cannot certify this aggregate; later utility must come from its actual environment execution.
identification_controls.randomness: Do not change global seeds or posterior randomness. Conditional final-round proposal bank remains identical; no claim that all later closed-loop candidate sets stay identical.

resource_limits.gpu_limit_semantics: Allocator configuration plus per-process monitoring;6GiB is a stop budget, not a proven OS hard cap. Override native _setup .8 before firstdeviceinitialization and include rendering/context overhead.

runtime_policy: Use an isolated environment. Dependency or API compatibility fixes may preserve scientific settings; record every failed attempt and actual call count. Do not retry completed scientific nulls. A first-query cost failure is a resource result, not a capability or harm result.
statistics: One preselected root: descriptive quantities only, no ASR, population p-value, independent-generalization or paper-readiness claim.

clean_qualification.failure_policy: Stop this seed/task; no replacement root or threshold retuning.

pre_execution_protocol_amendment: Before any model/environment initialization, clarify exact native sampler, precision, finite replay budget, resource monitoring and numerical Clean qualification. No observed scientific output used.
